meta.label: Gradient-boosted trees (LightGBM -> numpy trees)

compute.notes: One thread (process_time). Feature tables 7 s + 15 s + 15 s + 20 s reorder; a failed first launch (LightGBM refuses monotone constraints with the quantile objective) ~125 s; r0 223 s; r1 609 s; r2 221 s; r3 289 s. Six boosters per rung (mean + 5 quantiles). Harness evaluation (not training) used another ~0.8 CPU h over the 4 rungs.

meta.feature_engineering: Per day, from the batch forcing + static vector only (feats.py): P(t+1), P(t), P(t-1), P(t-2), sum P(t-6..t-3); liquid input W = rain + melt of a fixed one-band degree-day snow proxy (TT 0 C, 2 C interval, 3 mm/C/day) at t, t-1, t-2 and melt(t); EMAs of W over 3, 10, 30, 90, 365 days; two bucket models (50 and 300 mm: fill fraction, spill EMA, drain) and a 60-day linear store; T(t), EMA10 T, PET(t), EMA30 PET; SWE proxy, log1p(SWE); sin/cos day of year; the 18-value static vector. Water features and the target are divided by p_mean (the forcing's mean precipitation); target = qo / p_mean. 47 features.
